name: Pipedrive
summary: This guide explains how to connect your service to Pipedrive by creating and configuring your own OAuth 2.0 app in the Pipedrive Developer Hub, including collecting credentials, setting the required redirect URI, and handling app approval for production or marketplace use.
decision: You must create your own OAuth app in Pipedrive Developer Hub, specify the exact callback URL, select correct access scopes, copy your credentials, and use them to enable OAuth 2.0 integration in your platform or server—there is no managed OAuth available for Pipedrive.

setup_path.label: Setup path
setup_path.note: Managed OAuth is not available for Pipedrive; you are required to bring and register your own OAuth credentials.

prerequisites.title: Pipedrive Developer Sandbox account
prerequisites.body: You must have a Developer Sandbox account to access Developer Hub and manage OAuth apps.

prerequisites.title: Access to your integration platform
prerequisites.body: You need access to the platform (e.g., Apideck, Composio, your own app server) where the OAuth credentials will be used.

steps.title: Access Pipedrive Developer Hub
steps.body: Login to your Pipedrive Developer Sandbox account, click your profile icon, then select Developer Hub.

steps.title: Create a new OAuth app
steps.body: In the Developer Hub, select to create a new app. Choose app type (private or public) as needed, enter the app name, and set the callback URL exactly as needed for your platform (e.g., Apideck or Glitch live URL and path).
steps.note: The callback URL must match exactly or the OAuth flow will fail.

steps.title: Set OAuth scopes
steps.body: Select API scopes matching your integration needs (e.g., 'Deals - Full Access', etc.) in the OAuth & Access scopes section.

steps.title: Save and copy credentials
steps.body: After saving, retrieve the generated Client ID and Client Secret. Copy these and store them securely in your config or environment, never sharing your Secret.
steps.note: Do not expose secrets in source code.

steps.title: Change app status to Live / Send for review
steps.body: Private apps: Click Change to Live to use the app in your account. Public apps: Complete the marketplace listing form and send for Pipedrive review. The app is only usable by others once set to Live.

steps.title: Configure your integration
steps.body: In your integration platform (Apideck, Composio custom OAuth config, or your server environment), provide the Client ID, Client Secret, and ensure the callback/redirect URI matches your Pipedrive app registration.
steps.note: Initiate connection from your platform, not via Pipedrive's Install/Test button.

steps.title: Test the OAuth connection
steps.body: Initiate the OAuth flow from your integration, authorize the app, and verify the connection is successful.
steps.note: Do not test from inside Pipedrive’s OAuth app settings.

blockers.title: No Developer Sandbox account
blockers.body: OAuth app registration is not possible in production Pipedrive accounts; only sandbox accounts may use Developer Hub.

blockers.title: Restricted app usage in Draft
blockers.body: Apps in Draft status can only be used within their creator’s organization until made Live or approved after review.

blockers.title: Redirect URI mismatch causes OAuth failure
blockers.body: If the redirect URI in your integration does not exactly match the registered callback URL, authorization will fail.

human_actions.title: Register a Pipedrive OAuth App
human_actions.body: Log in to the Developer Hub and create a new OAuth app, specifying name, callback URL, and selecting the correct scopes.

human_actions.title: Copy credentials to your platform
human_actions.body: Copy the Client ID and Client Secret and configure them on your platform (e.g., as environment variables or in a credentials editor).

human_actions.title: Change app to Live or submit for review as required
human_actions.body: Depending on your needs, either change your app to Live or submit for review so that users outside your own account can authorize it.

human_actions.title: Configure your integration and test OAuth flow
human_actions.body: Initiate the OAuth authorization from your integration platform (not from inside Pipedrive) and test a full connection.
